title: Whale eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- whale body -->
  <ellipse cx="48" cy="58" rx="36" ry="24" fill="#3A8FD4"/>
  <!-- whale lighter belly -->
  <ellipse cx="48" cy="66" rx="28" ry="14" fill="#7FC4F0"/>
  <!-- whale head bump -->
  <ellipse cx="22" cy="52" rx="18" ry="16" fill="#4AA0E0"/>
  <!-- whale mouth/open area -->
  <ellipse cx="14" cy="58" rx="10" ry="8" fill="#2A6FA8"/>
  <!-- whale eye -->
  <circle cx="28" cy="48" r="4" fill="#F5F9FF"/>
  <circle cx="28" cy="48" r="2" fill="#1E4A6E"/>
  <!-- whale smile line -->
  <path d="M10 62 Q18 68 26 64" stroke="#A8DDF7" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d="M82 50 Q94 38 96 46 Q90 52 96 58 Q94 66 82 56 Z" fill="#2E7BC0"/>
  <!-- fin -->
  <path d="M44 76 Q40 88 52 84 Q46 80 48 76 Z" fill="#2E7BC0"/>
  <!-- snack: a little fish sandwich -->
  <rect x="12" y="54" width="10" height="6" rx="2" fill="#F2B84B"/>
  <rect x="12" y="52" width="10" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#E88A3A"/>
  <circle cx="15" cy="58" r="1" fill="#8B5E2A"/>
  <circle cx="19" cy="58" r="1" fill="#8B5E2A"/>
  <!-- bubbles -->
  <circle cx="8" cy="44" r="2.5" fill="#B8E6FA"/>
  <circle cx="4" cy="36" r="1.8" fill="#B8E6FA"/>
  <circle cx="10" cy="32" r="1.5" fill="#B8E6FA"/>
  <!-- water spout -->
  <path d="M40 32 Q42 24 38 20 M40 32 Q44 26 48 22 M40 32 Q36 26 34 22" stroke="#B8E6FA" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- little sparkle -->
  <path d="M70 30 l2 4 l4 2 l-4 2 l-2 4 l-2 -4 l-4 -2 l4 -2 z" fill="#FBD64B"/>
</svg>
